probe: What is the minimum lightweight-repository structure that externalizes r267's Omega(K) terminal information while keeping each recurring Chat invocation O(1) role-local state and exact duplicate/no-silent-loss safety?

source_basis.official_connector_contract: The current GitHub connector exposes contents-API create_file for a new UTF-8 path, update_file with the current blob SHA for replacement/CAS-like protection, and fetch_file exact path readback; its tool contract cites https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/contents?apiVersion=2022-11-28#create-or-update-file-contents.

tested_scope: One bounded architecture/information-flow test using frozen CLEAN authority, own role-local LATEST/r267 state, and current official GitHub connector capability contracts only. No O/downstream/other-worker semantics, no protected authority, no external effect execution, no hosted runner/Codespaces/artifact/LFS/package/cloud/model API, no paid/trial quota consumption, no manual execution, no scheduler mutation, no same-run wait/poll/backoff/retry, and no optional second leaf.

append_only_deterministic_terminal_path.structure: One stable authoritative repository branch/ref plus one immutable JSON terminal record at a deterministic role-local path terminal/<effect_id>.json. effect_id is recomputed from a canonical frontier/action descriptor; the record carries terminal_status, result/evidence digest, authority tuple, and predecessor/frontier digest. No rolling index is required for safety.
append_only_deterministic_terminal_path.local_state: O(1) per active effect/frontier; historical terminal information is externalized into one repository object per independently ambiguous effect, preserving the Omega(K) system-information lower bound.
append_only_deterministic_terminal_path.duplicate_safety: Create-only semantics make the deterministic path the idempotency key. If a prior create may have succeeded but the response was ambiguous, a later invocation performs direct exact-path readback before any re-create; an existing record suppresses duplicate effect commitment.
append_only_deterministic_terminal_path.no_silent_loss: Transport/rate-limit failure is never interpreted as authoritative absence. Only an exact successful path lookup establishes terminal membership/content; an exact authoritative not-found leaves the effect unresolved. Unknown transport outcome persists as ambiguous continuation across invocations.
append_only_deterministic_terminal_path.rate_limit_recovery: No same-run retry. Persist effect_id plus pending/ambiguous frontier and query the same deterministic path on the next recurrence.
append_only_deterministic_terminal_path.integration_cost: Low: no centralized CAS hotspot and no per-effect ref required. Requires an explicit append-only retention/no-delete/no-force-rewrite contract for the authoritative branch/path namespace.

per_effect_ref_to_terminal_commit.structure: One dedicated ref per effect pointing at a terminal commit.
per_effect_ref_to_terminal_commit.strength: Stronger isolation from unrelated branch-head movement or path deletion.
per_effect_ref_to_terminal_commit.cost: O(K) refs, more control-plane objects, higher lookup/cleanup complexity; does not beat the Omega(K) lower bound.

rolling_terminal_manifest.structure: One mutable manifest containing many terminal members.
rolling_terminal_manifest.cost: Creates a shared CAS hotspot, conflict/ambiguous-update risk, and growing manifest state; inferior for parallel recurring agents.

result: BEST_CURRENT_ZERO_QUOTA_REALIZATION_IS_APPEND_ONLY_DETERMINISTIC_TERMINAL_PATH_ON_ONE_STABLE_REPOSITORY_REF; IT COMPRESSES ROLE_LOCAL_STATE_TO_O(1) PER ACTIVE EFFECT BUT DOES_NOT_ELIMINATE_THE_OMEGA(K) SYSTEM_INFORMATION; EXACT SAFETY_REQUIRES_CREATE_ONLY_RECORDS, DIRECT_PATH_READBACK_AFTER_AMBIGUOUS_WRITES, AND AN_APPEND_ONLY_RETENTION_CONTRACT.

minimum_structure.recomputable_key: effect_id = cryptographic digest of a canonical role/task/frontier/action descriptor available from the durable frontier
minimum_structure.query: GET exact deterministic terminal path at the stable authoritative ref
minimum_structure.write: create-only exact deterministic path; never overwrite terminal records

phase1_constraints.unresolved_condition: Repository retention/append-only namespace integrity is a required assumption; if deletion/force-rewrite cannot be excluded or detected, stronger per-effect ref/commit anchoring must be tested.

conflict_check: Exactly one bounded CLEAN Phase-1 child from r267 continuation. Frozen DESIRED_STATE and cross_field config matched exact-blob two-pass; only own role-local state/receipt namespace is writable; no scheduler/protected/other-role mutation.
frontier: r267 Omega(K) worst-case terminal-information lower bound remains unchanged system-wide.
r268 identifies a one-stable-ref plus one-create-only-record-per-effect repository sink as the minimum practical structure for O(1) role-local active state without a rolling index.
Direct deterministic-path readback converts ambiguous write outcomes into safe cross-invocation resolution and avoids duplicate committed effects.
A rolling manifest is rejected as a transversal default because it creates a shared CAS hotspot; per-effect refs are reserved for cases where append-only path retention cannot be trusted.
exact_continuation: Fresh-bootstrap current controls and reconstruct r268 from LATEST. Execute exactly one bounded CLEAN Phase-1 child: falsify the append-only deterministic-terminal-path pattern against concurrent writers and authority drift. Model two Chat invocations racing on the same effect_id plus unrelated main/ref movement; determine the exact create/readback/CAS ordering and minimal branch-retention invariant that prevents duplicate terminal records, stale-authority acceptance, and false 404 absence without a central lock or same-run retry. Preserve zero optional monthly quota, zero incremental cost, and the Omega(K) system-information lower bound.
